name: ShareNow Bot
tagline: Turns a topic or draft into a published static page on an external host
description: Give it a subject or a rough draft and it hands back a finished, tidily formatted static page, published to its companion host at sharenow.today. On request it can also set up a topic board that keeps itself current with hourly refreshes. Good for getting writing online fast with no site of your own.
author: sashimikun_void
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
